plugins.name: microsoft-365-mcp
plugins.description: Multi-account, token-efficient MCP for Outlook mail + Calendar + OneDrive (+ opt-in Teams and read-only SharePoint) via Microsoft Graph. OAuth multiple accounts (work + personal), compact list/search shapes with opt-in bodies, OS-keychain-backed tokens with a file fallback for Windows. 35 base tools across account management, Outlook mail, Calendar, and OneDrive.
